cultural.vision_reason: The image shows a reindeer-skin drawstring bag with felted wool panels, beadwork cross motif, and bone/ivory ring border — a form and decorative style consistent with Sámi craft traditions using reindeer hide, felt appliqué, and beadwork. This matches the claimed Sámi origin well.

physical.title: bag
physical.summary:
Reindeer-skin bag, pouch-shaped, with drawstring handle made of twisted reindeer-skin with tassels at each end formed of red and green felted wool (?) and looped strings of white, pink, red and colourless glass beads; on each side a panel of felted wool (?) with beadwork embroidery in the form of a central cross motif set on fabric of contrasting colour, beaded border, and, round the edge, a series of ivory or bone rings hung from glass bead loops.  
On one side the cross is in yellow and colourless glass beads on blue felted wool against a red felted wool background, with purple glass bead border; on the other, the cross is in pink and orange beads on yellow felted wool against a green felted wool background, with pink and red beaded border. At the top of each panel is a band of contrasting red or green felted wool.
